[1;90mSTANDING HEXAGRAM NAME:

[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m乾

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mI. The Khien Hexagram


[1;90mSTANDING HEXAGRAM STRUCTURE:

  [90m互卦 Nuclear Hexagram:  [1;97m#1 乾 / I. The Khien Hexagram[0m
  [90m錯卦 Inverse Hexagram:  [1;97m#2 坤 / II. The Khwăn Hexagram[0m
  [90m綜卦 Reversed Hexagram: [1;97m#1 乾 / I. The Khien Hexagram[0m


[1;90m卦辭:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m乾：元亨，利貞。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mKhien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm.

[1;90m大象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m天行健，君子以自強不息。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mI. Heaven, in its motion, (gives the idea of) strength. The superior man, in accordance with this, nerves himself to ceaseless activity.
